comment: Automated review by Greptile. Advisory only: findings are verified against the code before action and never gate a merge.
instructions: Comment only on defects that would change stored data, break a documented contract, weaken an authority or role check, or make a test pass for the wrong reason. Do not comment on style, naming, or formatting. Use New Zealand English. Before flagging a fixture change, check whether the pull request states that the fixture is regenerated by its --check script.

rules.rule: Evidence versions are immutable and hashed over canonical JSON; a change to canonicalisation, hashing, or the envelope must keep every committed fixture byte-identical or bump the contract version and say so.
Every public mutation or action must resolve the acting user through the shared authority helpers and enforce the documented role; never trust a caller-supplied identity or role.
Frozen export batches, review snapshots, and accepted decisions are never rewritten in place; supersession and withdrawal preserve stored bytes.
Schema changes must be additive unless the pull request names a migration and its operator; removed or renamed fields and narrowed validators are blocking findings.
A change to portal behaviour must update the RA guide (apps/guides/ra.html) or state why the guide is unaffected.
Data products (area summaries, bundles, manifests) are validated against the JSON schemas under schemas/; a schema change needs its validator and fixture updated in the same pull request.

other.context: Places-of-worship research platform: a Convex backend (convex/) behind static portals (apps/), a Rust verification and export CLI (crates/pow-cli), Python and Node build scripts (scripts/), and JSON contracts (schemas/). Continuous integration runs typecheck, node tests, Python unittest, cargo test, and fixture --check scripts.
